description: This file implements base64 encoding and decoding functions, including context management, length calculations, and constant-time operations for cryptographic safety.

methods.name: constant_time_lt_args_8
methods.description: Performs a constant-time less-than comparison between two uint8_t arguments.

methods.name: constant_time_in_range_8
methods.description: Checks if a uint8_t value is within a specified range in constant time.

methods.name: conv_bin2ascii
methods.description: Converts a 6-bit binary value to its base64 ASCII character in constant time.

methods.name: EVP_EncodedLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of base64 encoded data given input length.

methods.name: EVP_ENCODE_CTX_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new EVP_ENCODE_CTX structure.

methods.name: EVP_EncodeUpdate
methods.description: Encodes input data into base64, managing partial data and line breaks.

methods.name: EVP_EncodeFinal
methods.description: Finalizes base64 encoding, outputting remaining data.

methods.name: EVP_EncodeBlock
methods.description: Encodes a block of binary data into base64 string.

methods.name: EVP_DecodedLength
methods.description: Calculates the maximum decoded length for base64 data.

methods.name: base64_ascii_to_bin
methods.description: Converts a base64 ASCII character to its binary value in constant time.

methods.name: base64_decode_quad
methods.description: Decodes four base64 characters into up to three bytes.

methods.name: EVP_DecodeUpdate
methods.description: Decodes base64 input data, handling whitespace and errors.

methods.name: EVP_DecodeFinal
methods.description: Finalizes base64 decoding, checking for errors.

methods.name: EVP_DecodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes base64 data into binary, handling length and padding.

methods.name: EVP_DecodeBlock
methods.description: Decodes a block of base64 data into binary, trimming whitespace and handling padding.
